# Audette IT

> Tech help from one person, Michael, in Las Vegas: everyday fixes (wifi, slow computers, new computer setup, backups, printers, TVs and smart home, accounts, parental controls) plus bigger projects (network design, Active Directory, self-hosted services, security hardening). In person around Las Vegas, or remotely from anywhere. Quote before any work. Not a registered business. Contact: michael.audette@audetteit.com

Every page on this site has a Markdown version. Append `.md` to the page path, or request the normal URL with an `Accept: text/markdown` header.

## Pages

- [Home](https://audetteit.com/index.md): Who Audette IT is, what it helps with room by room, and how it works
- [Services](https://audetteit.com/services.md): Everything I help with, around the house and bigger projects
- [How it works](https://audetteit.com/how-it-works.md): The three steps, in person vs remote, and common questions
- [About](https://audetteit.com/about.md): Who you'll be dealing with
- [Contact](https://audetteit.com/contact.md): Email address and how the contact form works
- [Privacy](https://audetteit.com/privacy.md): What the site collects: contact form, opt-in Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity, hosting
